remediations.justification: Restricts PassRole to only the application role prefix (AppRole-*) and only when passed to EC2, closing the unrestricted admin-role pivot that enabled credential theft via RunInstances.

This novel cross-account trust chain requires architectural review — the reverse trust from account 222222222222 back to AdminRole in 111111111111 should be evaluated by both account owners before modifying trust policies.
Scopes the wildcard PassRole down to the AppRole- prefix and restricts the receiving services to EC2 and Lambda only, eliminating the ability to pass arbitrary roles including AdminRole.
